0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) are on the road at the Pacers (2-2, 3rd in the Central, one game back), with Philadelphia coming off a loss and Indiana also on a one-game skid. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle, sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring, strain), and Obi Toppin is day-to-day with a hand sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the 76ers won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
